title: 第十一章修炼第十二章和凶鸟王对峙
content_zh:
当秦风意识苏醒，睁开双眸时，便看见了他此生都无法忘怀的一幕。
只见眼前有一块巨大无比的灵玉，浑身散发着乳白色的灵光，还有一股能够温暖身躯的灵气。
整块灵玉，无法用言语形容其完美程度，秦风瞪大瞳孔，瞠目结舌道：“你.....你就是通灵神玉？”
“没错，这是我的本体所在。”
“主人，好好修炼吧，这些年我吸收了不少灵气，足够让你在这里安静修炼三个月。”
“另外，那九龙至尊诀，要想不断提升，则需要很多龙血才行，而且还是不同程度的龙血，才能让此神法更加强大，你才能修炼到九种龙体的地步。”
“至于究竟该如何修炼，想必，你脑海里已经有过画面了。”
“我建议您配合九龙至尊鼎一起修炼，如此一来，既能修炼神法，还能掌控至尊鼎。”
“以主人您的天赋，即便没有苏醒记忆，应该也能轻易掌控九龙至尊诀和至尊鼎了。”
“若有不清楚的地方，可问我。”
玉灵回应道。
秦风闻言，本有许多问题想问，但响起龙野爷爷为了保护自己而牺牲的那一幕后，他也只能强忍好奇心，点点头道：“好的，我这就开始修炼。”
说罢，秦风便闭起了眼睛。
脑海里则是出现了九龙至尊诀的修炼方法以及过程。
第一诀，则是黑龙诀。
修炼此术，必须要让灵气能够转换成龙气以及龙威，寻常修士肯定难以做到，除非能够吞噬龙血，来让自身血脉发生改变。
而龙家之人体内便流淌着稀薄的龙血，虽不强大，但也足以能够修炼九龙至尊诀第一诀了。
按理说，秦风现在是无法修炼此门神法的，但却因为通灵神玉这些年在龙家吸收了不少龙气，于是导致秦风体内已然有着龙气存在，只不过一直被通灵神玉所封印着，所以才无法爆发出来。
如今玉灵苏醒，自然要将龙气灌入秦风体内。
所以秦风才能在没有龙血的情况下，修炼九龙至尊诀，但也只能修炼第一诀了。

要想修炼出后续八种龙体，则需要大量不同属性的龙血才行，光靠龙气，已然无用......
龙气炼体，便是修炼九龙至尊诀最基础的一步。
而这一步，则需要承受肉体被龙气所冲击，炼体所带来的巨大痛苦才行。
意志力不坚定或者难以承受痛苦者，也就无法修炼这一门强大的神法了。
秦风屏气凝神，将体内龙气引入身体里的每一个细胞之中，一次来让自身细胞得到强化，转而增强肉体，直到能够通过灵气转换肉体形态，才算修炼成功。
这看似简单的过程，却足以让许多修士，望而止步。
砰！
随着一声巨响，只见秦风身上赫然出现了一朵血雾，那是在右臂之处。
疼痛感顿时席卷全身，让秦风面目扭曲，咬牙切齿，痛苦难耐。
“该死，龙气太强，细胞炸裂，再这样下去，恐怕自己都得把自己玩死。”
秦风痛苦说道。
他极力让体内龙气显得温和一点，但却因为自身肉体不够强大，体内细胞压根承受不了龙气的灌入，一碰就炸，一炸就碎，自然就会爆出血雾来了。
“主人，先要学会掌控龙气强弱，慢慢来龙气一丝丝炼化细胞才行。”
“否则你只会受伤更重，直到彻底无法修炼为止。”
玉灵再次开口道。
“好，我知道了！”
秦风咬牙回应，右臂上被炸穿的地方，还在不断咕噜往外冒血，额头上早已冷汗直流。
“得先止血，再慢慢尝试了。”
“希望在这三个月里，自己能够修炼出来黑龙诀吧。”
秦风心有所想后，便调动体内灵气，先止住右臂上的伤口后，再继续尝试用龙气强化体内细胞。

......
与此同时，神玉空间外。
龙战正站在水潭旁边，表情冰冷的目视前方，在他脚下，有着好几头凶兽的尸体，其中甚至还有三品凶兽......
“该死的秦风！！”
content_en:
When Qin Feng regained consciousness and opened his eyes, he saw a scene that he would never forget in his life.
I saw a huge piece of spiritual jade in front of me, exuding a milky white spiritual light, and a spiritual energy that could warm my body.
The whole piece of spiritual jade cannot be described in words for its perfection. Qin Feng's pupils widened and he was dumbfounded and said: "You...are you the spiritual jade?"
"Yes, this is where my true identity lies."
"Master, practice hard. I have absorbed a lot of spiritual energy over the years, enough for you to practice quietly here for three months."
"In addition, if you want to continuously improve the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique, you need a lot of dragon blood, and there are different levels of dragon blood, so that this magical method can be more powerful, and you can cultivate to the point of nine kinds of dragon bodies."
"As for how to practice, you must have already had a picture in your mind."
"I suggest that you practice together with the Nine Dragons Supreme Cauldron. In this way, you can not only practice divine magic, but also control the Supreme Cauldron."
"With your talent, Master, you should be able to easily control the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique and the Supreme Cauldron even without awakening your memory."
"If there is anything unclear, you can ask me."
Yuling responded.
When Qin Feng heard this, he originally had many questions to ask, but after hearing the scene of Grandpa Long Ye's sacrifice to protect himself, he could only suppress his curiosity, nodded and said: "Okay, I will start practicing now."
After saying that, Qin Feng closed his eyes.
The method and process of practicing the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique appeared in his mind.
The first technique is the Black Dragon Technique.
To practice this technique, the spiritual energy must be converted into dragon energy and dragon power. It is definitely difficult for ordinary monks to do this, unless they can swallow the dragon's blood to change their own bloodline.
The people of the Long family have thin dragon blood flowing in their bodies. Although it is not powerful, it is enough to be able to practice the first trick of the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique.
It stands to reason that Qin Feng cannot practice this door god method now, but because the psychic jade has absorbed a lot of dragon energy in the Long family over the years, Qin Feng already has dragon energy in his body, but it has been sealed by the psychic jade, so it cannot burst out.
Now that Yu Ling wakes up, it is natural to pour dragon energy into Qin Feng's body.
That's why Qin Feng can practice the Nine Dragons Supreme Art without dragon blood, but he can only practice the first art.
If you want to cultivate the subsequent eight types of dragon bodies, you need a large amount of dragon blood with different attributes. Dragon energy alone is useless...
Refining the body with dragon energy is the most basic step in practicing the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique.
But for this step, you need to endure the tremendous pain caused by the dragon's energy impacting your body and refining your body.
Those who do not have strong willpower or cannot bear pain will not be able to practice this powerful divine method.
Qin Feng held his breath and concentrated, introducing the dragon energy in his body into every cell in his body, once to strengthen his own cells and then strengthen his body. Only when he can transform his physical form through spiritual energy can he be considered successful in cultivation.
This seemingly simple process is enough to make many monks stop.
Bang!
With a loud noise, a blood mist suddenly appeared on Qin Feng's body, which was on his right arm.
The pain suddenly swept through the whole body, making Qin Feng's face distorted, gnashing his teeth, and the pain was unbearable.
"Damn it, the dragon energy is too strong and the cells will explode. If this continues, I'm afraid I'll have to kill myself."
Qin Feng said painfully.
He tried his best to make the dragon energy in his body appear gentler, but because his body was not strong enough, the cells in his body couldn't bear the infusion of dragon energy. They exploded and shattered when touched, and blood mist naturally erupted.
"Master, you must first learn to control the strength of the dragon's energy, and then slowly refine the cells with the dragon's energy."
"Otherwise you will only be injured more seriously until you are completely unable to practice."
Yu Ling spoke again.
"Okay, I get it!"
Qin Feng gritted his teeth and responded, rightThe place where the arm was blasted was still bleeding out, and cold sweat was already pouring down his forehead.
"You have to stop the bleeding first, and then try slowly."
"I hope that in these three months, I can practice the Black Dragon Art."
After Qin Feng thought about it, he mobilized the spiritual energy in his body, first stopped the wound on his right arm, and then continued to try to use dragon energy to strengthen the cells in his body.
...
At the same time, outside the Shenyu space.
Long Zhan was standing next to the water pool, looking ahead with a cold expression. Under his feet, there were the corpses of several ferocious beasts, including even third-grade ferocious beasts...
"Damn Qin Feng!!"
